name: clefts-workbench
description: Run and inspect CLEFTS applications from VS Code.

clefts.pythonPath.description: Python executable used for CLEFTS CLI commands.

clefts.applicationRoot.description: Workspace-relative CLEFTS Python project directory. Empty enables automatic parent and mnt/app discovery.

clefts.workbench.defaultOutputDirectory.description: Default output root for preparation, training and prediction. Empty leaves output directories blank. Each new Workbench uses a named timestamp subdirectory. Relative paths are resolved against the CLEFTS project.

clefts.workbench.dataDefaults.markdownDescription: Default values for new Data Preparation forms. Use **Save as Workbench Defaults** in Workbench or edit this object in settings.json. Nested parameter objects are merged with built-in presets. Output directories are generated from Default Output Directory.

clefts.workbench.trainingDefaults.markdownDescription: Default values for new Training forms. Use **Save as Workbench Defaults** in Workbench or edit this object in settings.json. Nested parameter objects are merged with built-in presets. Output directories are generated from Default Output Directory.

clefts.workbench.predictionDefaults.markdownDescription: Default values for new Prediction forms. Use **Save as Workbench Defaults** in Workbench or edit this object in settings.json. Nested parameter objects are merged with built-in presets. Output directories are generated from Default Output Directory.
